fields.description: The vendor record this key dials: one vendor in one Geography. Set once; the same secret for another Geography is a second key.
fields.label: Model Provider

fields.description: Names this key for the operator, on the usage page and wherever it is linked, one per provider; the gateway never sees it.
fields.label: Title

fields.description: API Calls: pushed to the gateways, which dial it for requests. Billing: held for the vendor's billing API alone (Vendor Reconciliation) and pushed to no gateway, as an admin key that cannot serve a request must be. API Calls and Billing: one secret that does both.
fields.label: Used For
fields.options:
API Calls
Billing
API Calls and Billing

fields.description: One credential we hold with this vendor. One used for API calls is pushed to every gateway of the geography under this key's id; a customer's key never leaves us. Set once: a new secret is a new key, and this one is disabled.
fields.label: API Key

fields.description: Which vendor account this key belongs to: the one its calls are billed to, and a billing read (Vendor Reconciliation) happens once per account. Blank: the key is an account of its own.
fields.label: Account

fields.description: Used for nothing while ticked: pushed to no gateway, read no billing with. How a key is retired: it is never deleted, since its stats name it.
fields.label: Disabled
